story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. List view: Supports pagination (20 per page), sorting by name or code, filter on status (active/inactive), and typeahead search. 2. Add form: All required except for optional fields; real-time validation (e.g., phone number, email format, tax code checksum). 3. Autogenerates Customer Code (CUST-YYYY-NNNN) and ensures globally unique per company; number increments even if prior code deleted/deactivated. 4. Detect and reject duplicate customers by tax code (and optionally email/cell), displaying exactly where conflict occurred. 5. Inactive customers appear grayed-out and are moved to bottom or separate tab. 6. Users can deactivate/reactivate, with tooltip explaining that linked AR data will not be deleted. 7. CRUD actions update real-time (websockets or polling), so multiple users see live changes. 8. Show customer AR summary (open invoices, total owed, average payment days) in details panel. 9. Can export customer list to CSV/Excel. 10. Attempt to delete customer with existing invoices/payments blocked, with explanatory modal. 11. All field edits, activations/deactivations, and import actions logged to the audit trail with before/after data and responsible user.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.section: FR22: Customer Master Data Management, FR23: Create Sales Invoices, FR24: Record Customer Payments, FR25: AR Aging Report, NFR23: i18n Support
doc.snippet: The system must support CRUD operations for customers, linked to account 131. Customer master data includes code (auto-generated), name, tax code, address, email, phone, and status (active/inactive). Customers are used in sales invoices and AR tracking.

doc.title: Epic 2 Technical Specification
doc.section: Story 2.2: Customer Master Data Management (CRUD), Customer Entity, Customer API, Customer CRUD Workflow
doc.snippet: Epic 2: Master Data Management establishes foundational data governance. Customer Master Data: Full CRUD operations for customer records with auto-generated codes (CUST-YYYY-NNNN), duplicate detection by tax code, status management (active/inactive), AR summary integration, and import/export functionality. Customer entity includes: id, company_id, code, name, tax_code, address, email, phone, active, createdAt, updatedAt.

doc.title: Epic Breakdowns
doc.snippet: As an accountant, I want robust CRUD for all customers, including search/filter, import/export, so that AR tracking, validations, and compliance are always real-time accurate. List view supports pagination, sorting, filtering. Auto-generates Customer Code (CUST-YYYY-NNNN). Detect and reject duplicate customers by tax code.

doc.title: Decision Architecture
doc.section: Data Architecture, Multi-Tenancy Strategy, Technology Stack Details
doc.snippet: Enterprise accounting ERP system using Spring Boot 3.5.7 backend with React TypeScript frontend, PostgreSQL via Supabase. Multi-tenancy: Row-level filtering via company_id on all tables. Search: PostgreSQL FTS + unaccent for native Vietnamese unaccented search support. Database schema: snake_case table names (customers), UUID primary keys.

constraints.constraint: Multi-tenancy: All customer records must be company-scoped. Use CompanyScopedEntity interface pattern from Epic 1. All queries automatically filtered by company_id via CompanyContext.

Database schema: Follow PostgreSQL conventions: snake_case table names (customers), UUID primary keys (or BIGSERIAL), foreign keys with proper constraints. Unique constraint: UNIQUE(company_id, tax_code) at database level.

Customer code format: Auto-generated codes follow pattern CUST-YYYY-NNNN where YYYY is current year and NNNN is sequential number (e.g., CUST-2025-0001). Code generation must be thread-safe to prevent duplicates under concurrency. Use database sequence or atomic counter. Handle year rollover (reset sequence on new year).

Tax code validation: Vietnamese tax codes are 10-digit numeric strings. Validate format and enforce uniqueness per company via UNIQUE(company_id, tax_code) constraint. Use @Pattern annotation for format validation.

Duplicate detection: Check for duplicates by tax code (required), and optionally by email and phone number. When duplicate found, return 409 Conflict with details showing conflicting customer (code, name, tax code). Display exactly where conflict occurred in error message.

Referential integrity: Customers cannot be deleted if they have linked invoices or payments (Epic 5 data). Check references before deletion, return 409 Conflict with explanatory message listing count of linked records. Option to deactivate instead of delete.

Vietnamese search: Use PostgreSQL unaccent extension for unaccented search support (NFR23). Create custom function unaccent_search(text) in Flyway migration for use in search queries. Search must match accented field reliably (e.g., "nha" matches "nhà").

Audit logging: All customer CRUD operations must be logged to audit_logs table with before/after values in JSONB format. Include user ID, company ID, timestamp, IP address, user agent. Import operations create one audit entry per imported row. Log blocked delete attempts with reason.

Import/export: Use Apache POI for Excel parsing. Import must be atomic (all valid rows or none). Validate all rows before saving, collect errors, return error report with row numbers. Export supports CSV and Excel formats with applied filters. Log export action in audit trail.
Real-time updates: For MVP, use polling every 5 minutes to refresh customer list. WebSocket support can be added post-MVP. CRUD actions update real-time so multiple users see live changes.

AR summary integration: Customer AR summary (open invoices, total owed, average payment days) requires Epic 5 (AR Module) data. For MVP, stub the summary or return placeholder values. Show placeholder message if AR data not available.

Frontend: Use shadcn/ui components (not MUI) - architecture uses shadcn/ui. Follow feature-first structure: pages in features/customers/pages/, components in features/customers/components/. Use TanStack Table (data-table-09 pattern) for customer list.

RBAC: All authenticated users can view customers; edit requires admin/accountant roles. Use @PreAuthorize annotations for API security. Frontend UI hiding is not a security boundary - API must enforce permissions.

Form validation: Use React Hook Form with Zod schema validation. Real-time validation: show inline errors on field blur. Validate phone number format, email format, tax code format (10-digit Vietnamese tax code).

Inactive customer display: Inactive customers appear grayed-out (reduced opacity) and are moved to bottom or separate tab (user preference). Deactivate/reactivate with tooltip explaining that linked AR data will not be deleted.

tests.standards: Backend: JUnit 5 + Spring Boot Test with TestContainers for integration tests. Mockito for service unit tests (code generation, validation, duplicate detection). Frontend: Vitest + Testing Library + jsdom for component tests. Integration: Test full customer flow: create → edit → deactivate → view AR summary → export → import. Performance: Measure customer list load time (< 2s target per NFR1) for 1000+ customers. Accessibility: Test keyboard navigation, screen reader support (WCAG AA compliance).

Frontend test: Verify inactive customers appear grayed-out (reduced opacity) and moved to bottom or separate tab

Integration test: Verify customer AR summary (stubbed for MVP) - returns placeholder values until Epic 5 implemented
Integration test: Verify export functionality - generates CSV/Excel with applied filters, includes all customer fields, logs export action
Integration test: Verify delete blocked if customer has linked invoices/payments - returns 409 Conflict with explanatory message, option to deactivate
Integration test: Verify audit logging - all CRUD operations logged with before/after values, import operations create one audit entry per row, blocked delete attempts logged
Integration test: Verify company scoping - customers from different companies are isolated, queries filtered by company_id
Integration test: Verify import atomicity - all valid rows or none, error report with row numbers, export with filters
Performance test: Verify customer list load time < 2s for 1000+ customers, search with unaccented Vietnamese < 500ms
